task.question: Who won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2026 Grammy Awards?
task.evidence: Best Dance/Electronic Recording | Tame Impala | End Of Summer

URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grammy_Award_for_Best_Dance/Electronic_Recording
Starting from the 66th Annual Grammy Awards in 2024, a sister category Best Dance Pop Recording, was established in order to prevent well-established pop artists who incorporate dance music into their work from dominating the category over dedicated dance acts.

2. Best Dance/Electronic Recording 2026 Winners & Nominees
URL: https://www.grammy.com/awards/categories/best-dance-electronic-recording/2026/
The Grammy Award for Best Dance/Electronic Recording recognizes excellence in recordings from established dance and electronic genres, such as house, techno, trance, dubstep, drum & bass, and electronica, as well as other emerging dance and electronic genres.

3. Grammy Awards 2026: Dance & Electronic Winners (Full List)
URL: https://offtheknob.com/grammy-awards-2026-dance-electronic-winners-full-list/
Dance and electronic music claimed its moment at the 2026 Grammy Awards. From bold victories by FKA twigs and Tame Impala to defining wins over nominees like Fred again, Skrillex, explore the records and artists shaping the future of electronic sound.

Best Dance/Electronic Recording
The Grammy Award for Best Dance/Electronic Recording recognizes excellence in recordings from established dance and electronic genres, such as house, techno, trance, dubstep, drum & bass, and electronica, as well as other emerging dance and electronic genres. Eligible recordings feature significant electronic-based instrumentation generally based around a rhythmic dance beat.
